Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my details without the name, if that's okay. I was the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine for now. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I was turning left across the lanes to get into a shopping center
driveway.
Q: What was the traffic like when you started your turn?
A: Light, honestly. There was one car coming from the opposite direction that I thought was far enough away. Then
another vehicle came through fast and hit the driver's side of my car.
Q: Did you have a green light or a left-turn signal?
A: I had a green arrow. I'm fairly sure of that.
Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?
A: They said they were looking at their phone for a second. I didn't see that myself, so I can only tell you what they
told me.
Q: Are you injured?
A: Yes. My right knee took the brunt of it against the door and dasbhoard area. It's swollen and I can't bend it fully. I
went to urgent care that afternoon and they referred me for imaging.
Q: Have you been able to work since the collision?
A: I've been out for a few days. Lifting and standing for long periods is hard right now.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I've been cooperative and I'll send over the urgent care paperwork and photos of the car when you need
them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
